nodes.label: Sam
nodes.desc: Top-level nn.Module tying image encoder, prompt encoder, and mask decoder into one forward pass.

nodes.label: ImageEncoderViT
nodes.desc: MAE-style ViT that turns a 1024x1024 image into a 64x64 embedding grid with global attention every few blocks.

nodes.label: PatchEmbed
nodes.desc: Conv2d-based 16x16 patch tokenizer producing patch tokens plus positional embeddings.

nodes.label: Block
nodes.desc: Transformer block that switches between windowed and global attention depending on global_attn_indexes.

nodes.label: PromptEncoder
nodes.desc: Embeds points, boxes, and mask prompts into sparse and dense token sets for the decoder.

nodes.label: MaskDecoder
nodes.desc: Lightweight decoder that cross-attends image and prompt tokens and emits candidate masks plus IoU scores.

nodes.label: TwoWayTransformer
nodes.desc: Bidirectional transformer where image tokens attend to prompts and prompts attend to image tokens.

nodes.label: MLP
nodes.desc: Output hypernetwork MLP mapping mask tokens to upscaled embedding coefficients.

nodes.label: SamPredictor
nodes.desc: Interactive wrapper: set_image once, then predict masks for arbitrary points, boxes, or masks.

nodes.label: SamAutomaticMaskGenerator
nodes.desc: Generates whole-image masks automatically via a grid of point prompts, crops, and NMS-style filtering.

nodes.label: ResizeLongestSide
nodes.desc: Resizes images to the encoder side length and maps prompt coordinates back and forth.

nodes.label: sam_model_registry
nodes.desc: Dict mapping vit_b / vit_l / vit_h model types to checkpoint builder functions.
